title: Dave Dorman
description: "Although they may play a minor role, the droids are the indispensable workhorses of the STAR WARS movie universe, and deserve to be spotlighted," observes Dave Dorman. An Illustrator for twelve years, Dorman is best known for his photo-realistic renderings of adventure and science-fiction subjects, including BATMAN, STAR WARS, INDIANA JONES and DUNGEONS AND DRAGONS. ALIENS: TRIBES, an illustrated novel featuring 24 of his paintings, has recently been released.
